thread:
anna: FYI support ticket: user sees duplicated micro-charges when a streaming session truncates, a toolcall runs, then the stream resumes on a different route.
diego: paste logs?
anna: session=zz-42, model=redwood-small
```
13:02:10 REQ sess=zz-42 route=us-central prefix=22
13:02:12 STREAM_TRUNC sess=zz-42 trunc=1 provisional=true
13:02:12 TOOLCALL sync sess=zz-42 tokens=8
13:02:13 ROUTE_CHANGE sess=zz-42 to=us-backup
13:02:14 STREAM_RESUME sess=zz-42 resumed=26 confirmed=true
BILL provisional: 22+1 route=us-central
BILL confirmed: 26+8 route=us-backup
```
anna: customer billed for that +1 twice.
kevin: current dedupe keys = (session, route, charge_kind). toolcalls create separate charge_kind so the small truncated token gets orphaned. route-change makes it worse.
lynn: short-term: we can stop emitting provisional for truncations when a toolcall is active. downside = less early visibility.
paul: long-term: introduce a session-level provisional_nonce set on first provisional emission and carried on any subsequent provisional/confirmed events. confirmer looks up by nonce first.
diego: storage impact? we need index by nonce for ledger lookups. possible but fine.
kevin: also need to preserve per-route attribution for analytics. plan: store original_route in the provisional record and emit reconciled events that carry both original_route and final_route. console shows net billed tokens + breakdown where reconciled adjustments are visible.
billing-bot: Alert: orphaned_provisional_count=19 increased for last 30m.
anna: tests: simulate: truncate -> toolcall -> route_change -> resume; assert final ledger entry is single net charge and audit trail shows both routes.
paul: I'll add provisional_nonce field to truncate PR today. kevin will change confirmer to match by nonce if present. lynn will prototype analytics "reconciled_adjustment" row.
diego: backfill: run a reconciliation job scanning unmatched provisionals in last 72h matching by session/time overlap and nonce-like heuristics; flag candidate refunds.
anna: support: please hold ticket until backfill run. I'll post results.
paul: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/prov-nonce (WIP).
